ideas.pitch: An AI agent that inspects Kubernetes logs, Prometheus metrics, and traces upon an alert trigger to instantly generate a precise Root Cause Analysis (RCA) report and pull request fix.
ideas.problem_statement: An alert just fired. Checkout is failing. Can your team find out why before the clock runs out?
ideas.title: KubeDrift: Autonomous Kubernetes Root Cause Analysis Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core challenge of Keep Alive '26 by automating incident triage on microservices, mimicking the exact workflow of the 'Sharpest RCA' award criteria.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight log and metric replay engine that simulates checkout cascade failures in local Docker environments to train students for live incident response.
ideas.problem_statement: An alert just fired. Checkout is failing. Can your team find out why before the clock runs out?
ideas.title: AlertSleuth: Automated Microservice Observability Replay Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the practical learning curve of incident response platforms like Panic at the Pod by giving teams a reproducible testing playground.

ideas.pitch: A real-time anomaly detection service that hooks into Prometheus and Grafana webhooks to flag abnormal latency spikes in checkout microservices before total failure occurs.
ideas.problem_statement: An alert just fired. Checkout is failing. Can your team find out why before the clock runs out?
ideas.title: PodPulse: Prometheus Metric Anomaly Detector for E-commerce Checkouts
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a painful developer and DevOps problem by moving from reactive alerting to proactive anomaly detection using standard metrics.

ideas.pitch: A GitOps-driven pipeline that listens to Kubernetes crash loops, maps them to specific deployment manifest errors, and automatically opens a corrected pull request via ArgoCD.
ideas.problem_statement: An alert just fired. Checkout is failing. Can your team find out why before the clock runs out?
ideas.title: GitOpsIncidentFixer: Automated Remediation PRs for K8s Failures
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cloud-native orchestration with automated remediation, which appeals heavily to judges looking for deep Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes execution.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight Jaeger and OpenTelemetry trace visualizer tailored specifically to trace multi-service checkout bottlenecks and database connection pool exhaustion.
ideas.problem_statement: An alert just fired. Checkout is failing. Can your team find out why before the clock runs out?
ideas.title: TraceLens: Distributed Tracing Visualizer for Broken Checkout Flows
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an intuitive UI for parsing complex distributed traces, addressing the exact telemetry debugging required during the national championship finale.
